body.p: , completing 's "left out until needed" for Phase 2. processor.h, xpath.h, version.h; only new fields at the end of structs and new constants at the end of enumerations, so Phase 1 code compiles unchanged (zero keeps the old behaviour).

item.p: Decimal formats (static context): sxml_decimal_format (name, index 0 the unnamed format) with properties as text, {kind, value}, one kind per F&O 4.0 property (11). Text, not codepoints, because every source gives text (xsl:decimal-format attributes, XQuery declarations, QT4 decimal-format), and 4.0's marker-and-rendition form (%:pc, type '.|.:.*') parses once in sxml. An absent kind has its default. A breach (wrong form, markers not distinct, zero-digit not an Nd zero, duplicate names) is INVALID_ARGUMENT for the XPath API; XQuery and XSLT raise their own codes (XQST0097/8, XTSE1300) before handing formats over.

Collations (static context): default_collation_uri (empty is codepoint; XPath 4.0 puts it in the dynamic context, but every host knows it statically) and collation_bindings, host URIs that stand for a supported collation (the spec's "mapping from URI to collation"). sxml_collation_is_supported(uri) tells hosts and the QT4 driver which URIs sxml implements (); packet defines it in src/xpath.c over the collation lookup that 2.13 later completes. No host collation interface: keeps collations inside sxml.
Dynamic context: (empty is "en"), environment_variables (name/value views; sxml never reads the platform's), (null means the processor's).

Resources: kinds TEXT, BINARY, COLLECTION, URI_COLLECTION, XQUERY_MODULE, XSLT_MODULE, XSLT_PACKAGE, each with the forms it allows (a wrong form is INVALID_ARGUMENT); new form SEQUENCE with an owned items sequence for collections; request fields (fn:unparsed-text's argument; sxml decodes by the resource's encoding, then the request's, then BOM, then UTF-8), is_default_collection, (import module) and (xsl:use-package; uri_reference is the package name). The table resolver serves bytes for every kind that takes them. processor.c gains the SEQUENCE case of fn:doc's switch (INVALID_ARGUMENT).

Trace sink: one interface for fn:trace, fn:message and xsl:message (and failed xsl:assert): receive(state, event) with kind, label, value (borrowed sequence), is_terminating and for XSLT, location and processor; the null sink discards; a failure stops the evaluation; a sink may nest an evaluation, as a host function may. sxml_stream_trace_sink(&output_stream) writes label: value lines (adaptive, item separator " "): the default implementation and test double, defined by 2.12 in src/processor.c. processor.h now includes serialize.h (no cycle). The two new functions are declared only until 2.12; nothing calls them before.
Version: SXML_VERSION_ENCODE(major, minor, patch), SXML_VERSION_NUMBER and SXML_API_VERSION = 0.2.0, the first public release's API; 2.18 sets the version macros themselves.
Still left out, each a new field later: host extension functions, cancellation, a random seed, default calendar and place.
From now on these headers change only through a record until 0.2.0 (, ).
